QuestInfo.name: [Kin] The First Path of the Kin
QuestInfo.0: Radiant Hua, one of the Kin, wants to give you your first assignment to become one of the Kin.
QuestInfo.1:
To prove that you have the skills to become part of the Kin you need to collect #b10 Basic Kinship Symbols#k. 

#rTip!#kBasic Kinship Symbols can be acquired from the following monsters.
- #rDeo#k
- #rRurumo#k
- #rHomunscpecullo#k
- #rDeet and Roi#k
- #rChimera#k
QuestInfo.2: You have proven to Radiant Hua that you have what it takes to be part of the Kin. Radiant Hua has given you the #b#t3700151##k title and a #b#t1114000##k as a reward.

0.0: May the blessings of the Kin be with you! \r\nI'm going to give you your first task to become one of us! For love! And let's not forget joy! You ready?\r\n

yes.0: The Kin has been waiting for someone like you to join us. We just need proof that your heart is super-duper pure, which you can do by bringing me #b10 #i4033800##t4033800##k items!
yes.1:
Get #b#t4033800##k items from #rMystic Gates#k scattered throughout Maple World. The monsters you need to hunt are...

- #rDeo#k
- #rRurumo#k
- #rHomunscpecullo#k
- #rDeet and Roi#k
- #rChimera#k
yes.2: Got it? May love, joy, peace, and happiness be on your side! Rawr!

no.0: Remember, a person who doesn't surround themselves with love is a person who's, like, really sad and lonely.
